# Rainbow Polypack

> Rainbow Polypack is a premier PET preform manufacturer based in Gujarat, India (manufacturing facility in Chhatral GIDC, corporate office in Bodakdev, Ahmedabad). Specializing in precision injection moulding using advanced 100% Hot Runner Mould systems.

## Key Capabilities & Specifications
- **Core Product**: High-performance CTC 29/21mm series PET preforms.
- **Weights & Configurations**: Available in 10.2g, 11.5g, 12.5g, 13.5g, 14.5g, and customizable variants.
- **Manufacturing Standard**: 100% Virgin PET standard catalog; high-speed blow moulding compatibility; zero-defect weight tolerance (±0.15g) and total gate vestige thresholds (≤0.1mm).
- **Sustainability & rPET**: Food-grade rPET (Recycled PET) blending available on-demand for Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) compliance.
- **Facilities & Proximity**: Chhatral GIDC industrial facility located strategically near Ahmedabad with rapid logistics across India and export corridors.
